> 第887章 交朋友（第1页）
所以玩具车忍无可忍，直接说话了。
他告诉陈万星自己是住在玩具车里的鬼，叫豆子，但是他不会害人，刚刚那样做只是想和陈万星玩耍而已，不想吓唬他，所以才没有说话。
陈万星听到了豆子的声音，也很快意识到这个鬼的年纪应该和他差不多大，而且对方还是个男孩。
因为陈万星没有看过恐怖片，所以对于鬼怪的恐怖并不了解。
而在听了这个豆子稚嫩的声音和发言后，他还将其当成了和自己差不多的小朋友。
唯一的区别可能就是，一个是人一个是鬼，他看不见对方罢了。
但这并不妨碍他对豆子的友好与好奇。
陈万星喜欢交朋友，尤其是眼前的豆子和他所交过的朋友完全不一样，他更想和豆子认识，然后一起玩耍了。
豆子其实也没想到陈万星竟然一点都不害怕自己，反而还打算继续邀请自己一块玩。
要知道在他去世之后，便再也没有拥有过朋友了。
一开始的时候，他还试图找过和他年纪差不多的鬼当朋友。
但是和他年纪差不多大的鬼很少，就算有，他们也都更愿意回家陪父母。
唯独豆子的父母，在他去世之后便因为不想继续待在这里，以免触景伤情，已经搬离了这座城市。
至于年纪大一点的鬼，他们都嫌弃豆子太幼稚了，根本不想和他扎堆。
所以这么多年下来，豆子都是孤零零的一个鬼，而且他还害怕人群，就算看到附近有小朋友在玩，也不敢过去，只能远远地躲在墙角或者树后偷看。
这次陈万星跑过来，还找到了他一直当成“屋子”的玩具车，这不免让豆子又紧张又充满期待。
这辆小玩具车一直藏在这附近的小草下面，之前其实不是没有被人看到过，但看见过的人都嫌弃玩具车太旧太脏了，没有人愿意捡起来看看，或者把玩一下。
这次陈万星不仅看到它了，还丝毫不嫌弃地把它捡起来一起玩，这让豆子感到很激动，很开心。

而且或许是他们俩的年纪相差不大，豆子对陈万星的警惕也不高，所以很快就暴露了自己的身份。
他实在是太渴望能有小朋友陪自己一起玩了。
而在豆子明说了自己的身份后，陈万星便和他聊了起来，聊了一会之后，两人之间的陌生感便彻底消除，直接成了朋友。
陈万星觉得豆子孤零零留在外面很可怜，而且听豆子说，这些年他过得并不好，很多新出的零食，还有新玩具，他都没有再碰过。
正好他家里有不少玩具，而且零食水果也一大把，他一个人也吃不完，完全可以带上豆子回家让他也体验一下。
于是就这样，陈万星直接把玩具车揣兜里，带回了家。
之所以没敢光明正大的拿回家，就是担心爷爷奶奶看见玩具车这么破旧，会觉得这是他在外面捡的垃圾，然后让他丢掉。
因为豆子跟他说了，大人很害怕鬼，要是他家里人知道这辆玩具车里面住了一个鬼的话，绝对会立马把玩具车丢掉，甚至有可能直接销毁。
这可是自己的新朋友，而且豆子明明不会害人，就算把他带回家肯定也没事的。
不过豆子说的也有一些道理，万一爷爷奶奶真的要把玩具车丢掉，他一个小孩子，根本没办法反抗。
所以最后，他才背着爷爷奶奶把玩具车藏在兜里带回了家。

> Chapter 887 Making Friends (Page 1)
So Toy Car couldn't bear it anymore and spoke directly.
He told Chen Wanxing that he was a ghost living in a toy car named Douzi, but he would not harm anyone. He just wanted to play with Chen Wanxing and did not want to scare him, so he did not speak.
Chen Wanxing heard Douzi's voice and quickly realized that the ghost should be about the same age as him, and he was still a boy.
Because Chen Wanxing has never watched horror movies, he doesn't understand the horror of ghosts.
And after listening to Douzi's immature voice and speech, he regarded him as a child similar to himself.
The only difference may be that one is a human and the other is a ghost, and he can't see the other.
But this does not prevent him from being friendly and curious about beans.
Chen Wanxing likes to make friends, especially since the Douzi in front of him is completely different from the friends he has made before. He wants to get to know Douzi and play together.
Douzi actually didn't expect that Chen Wanxing was not afraid of him at all, and instead planned to continue inviting him to play together.
You know, after his death, he never had any friends again.
At the beginning, he tried to find ghosts who were about the same age as him as friends.
But there are very few ghosts around his age, and even if there are, they would rather go home to be with their parents.
Only Douzi's parents had moved away from the city after his death because they did not want to stay here any longer to avoid being hurt by the situation.
As for the older ghosts, they all thought Douzi was too childish and didn't want to hang out with him at all.
So after so many years, Douzi has been a lonely ghost, and he is also afraid of crowds. Even if he sees children playing nearby, he does not dare to go there. He can only hide in the corner or behind a tree to peek.
This time Chen Wanxing came over and found the toy car he had always regarded as his "house", which inevitably made Douzi nervous and full of expectations.
This little toy car has been hidden under the grass nearby. It has not been seen before, but everyone who has seen it thinks that the toy car is too old and dirty, and no one is willing to pick it up and look at it, or play with it.
This time Chen Wanxing not only saw it, but also picked it up and played with it without any disdain. This made Douzi very excited and happy.
And perhaps because they were not much different in age, Douzi was not very wary of Chen Wanxing, so his identity was quickly exposed.
He was really eager to have children to play with.
After Douziming revealed his identity, Chen Wanxing started chatting with him. After chatting for a while, the strangeness between the two was completely eliminated and they became friends directly.
Chen Wanxing felt pitiful for Douzi to be left alone outside, and he heard from Douzi that his life had not been good in recent years. He had never touched many of the new snacks and toys.
It just so happens that he has a lot of toys at home, and there are also a lot of snacks and fruits, which he can't finish by himself. You can bring the beans home and let him experience them too.
So just like that, Chen Wanxing put the toy car directly in his pocket and took it home.
The reason why I didn't dare to take it home openly was because I was worried that my grandparents would see the toy car so shabby and think it was garbage he picked up outside, and then let him throw it away.
Because Douzi told him that adults are very afraid of ghosts. If his family knew that a ghost lived in this toy car, they would definitely throw away the toy car immediately, or even destroy it directly.
This is his new friend, and Douzi obviously won't harm anyone, so it will definitely be fine even if he takes him home.
But there is some truth in what Douzi said, just in caseGrandparents really want to throw away the toy car, and as a child, he has no way to resist.
So in the end, he hid the toy car in his pocket and took it home behind his grandparents' back.
